adjudication.rationale: In lib/topic_retriever.rb#retrieved_recently?, the Redis throttle key is set via setnx/expire before perform_retrieve runs. If perform_retrieve/fetch_http raises (e.g., TopicEmbed.import_remote uses open(url).read with no rescue), the key will still remain until its 60s TTL expires, preventing another retrieval attempt during that window. This matches the finding’s behavior, but it appears to be an edge-case/UX concern around throttling semantics rather than a hard correctness break, since the key does expire and retries will eventually happen.
